objective: Can arbitrary fixed XORs of the left and right private product lists, one per evaluator, beat the 512-case midpoint construction on 31 products, and can any choice of both masks yield polynomially many cases as the path grows?
status: Complete: Two fixed local product XORs leave the optimal adaptive affine case count exponential with rate 2^(m/4). The 31-product optimum is between 342 and 512, with 512 exact for the midpoint and the full common-mask class.
title: Two separately revealed XORs of path products
